params.name: service
params.description: OGC service type

params.name: request
params.description: Operation to perform

params.name: version
params.description: Service version (WMS: 1.1.1 or 1.3.0; WCS: 1.0.0 or 2.0.1)

params.name: layers
params.description: Layer name(s) for WMS GetMap and GetFeatureInfo requests

params.name: bbox
params.description: Bounding box for spatial extent in format minX,minY,maxX,maxY

params.name: width
params.description: Output image width in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Output image height in pixels

params.name: format
params.description: Output format for map or coverage

params.name: crs
params.description: Coordinate reference system (WMS 1.3.0)

params.name: srs
params.description: Spatial reference system (WMS 1.1.1 equivalent of crs)

params.name: time
params.description: Temporal dimension filter in ISO 8601 format. Omitting returns most recent data.

params.name: styles
params.description: Style name for rendering. Use empty string for default.

params.name: coverage
params.description: Coverage identifier for WCS 1.0.0 GetCoverage

params.name: coverageId
params.description: Coverage identifier for WCS 2.0.1 GetCoverage

params.name: subset
params.description: Subset specification for WCS 2.0.1 (e.g. Long(130,145), Lat(30,45), time(2023-01-15T00:00:00Z))

params.name: query_layers
params.description: Layers to query for WMS GetFeatureInfo

params.name: X
params.description: Pixel X coordinate for WMS GetFeatureInfo

params.name: Y
params.description: Pixel Y coordinate for WMS GetFeatureInfo

params.name: info_format
params.description: Response format for WMS GetFeatureInfo

params.name: feature_count
params.description: Maximum number of features to return for GetFeatureInfo

params.name: layer
params.description: Single layer name for WMS GetLegendGraphic

items.docs: Unified OGC endpoint supporting Web Map Service (WMS) and Web Coverage Service (WCS) operations. The operation performed depends on the 'service' and 'request' parameters.
